text_block_list.text: One evening on a day off, as I passed near the school gate—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I heard Satono-chan hasn't gone home yet?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It appears so~
Shall we wait here a little longer then?~
choice_data_list: Did something happen to Satono Diamond?
Is something wrong with Satono Diamond?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're...
Satono-chan's Trainer, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, Palmer said she saw Satono-chan
heading out this morning.
Apparently, she went to the company.
Surprised by her unexpected words, I asked Mejiro Ryan for the full story. Apparently, she had visited one of the Satono family's offices.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: She said she'd be back by the evening, but she still hasn't returned, so I'm getting a little worried...
"I told them to leave the rest to me, and decided to give Satono Diamond a call."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "Oh, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: I heard you're still at the office?

text_block_list.text: I explained what happened, and told her that Mejiro Ryan and the others were worried.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "My, it seems I've caused you worry. But I am quite alright now. I have finished most of my errands."
choice_data_list: I'm worried, so I'll go pick them up.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "Are you sure? In that case, I'll arrange things so you can enter the office."

Entering the building I was told about,
I arrived at the floor where Satono Diamond was waiting.

Where could she be?
Looking around—

text_block_list.name: Satono Group Employee
text_block_list.text:
"—So, what shall we do
about the charity race?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
First, we must decide on the date
and the venue.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Mother and I will look over some candidates
before next week's meeting.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let us work together to gather as many people as we can♪
The person who appeared to be an employee eventually bowed and left the area.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you've arrived!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Currently, our group is planning a charity race as part of our philanthropic activities.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: As a member of the Satono family and an Umamusume, I wondered if there was anything I could do to help, so I am offering what little assistance I can.

As she said that, her expression was more dignified than ever,
showing just how strong a sense of responsibility she felt participating.
choice_data_list: As expected of a member of the Satono family.
As expected of a member of the Satono family.
Will you be participating in the charity race too?
Will you be participating in the charity race as well?

text_block_list.text:
As she said that, her expression was more dignified than ever,
showing just how strong a sense of responsibility she felt participating.
choice_data_list: As expected of a member of the Satono family.
As expected of a member of the Satono family.
Will you be participating in the charity race too?
Will you be participating in the charity race as well?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you very much♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
As someone who will one day lead the Satono family,
I wish to broaden my horizons while I still have time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, working like this as a member of the
Satono family fills me with motivation
to try even harder!"

In her smile as she spoke, the pride of someone
representing the Satono family was clearly visible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, welcome back! Satono-chan,
you look so energetic even though you just finished work.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I am one who shoulders the Satono family name, after all.
I must be able to handle at least this much♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, just like Palmer told me!
You're so much like McQueen in that way.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really!? Ryan-san,
I'd love to hear more about that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is my intention.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "As I mentioned earlier, I am a member of the Satono family, but I am also a competitor."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I may still be inexperienced, but someday I want to contribute to both the Satono family and the racing world!

Looking at her eyes gazing not just at the present but far beyond,
one could catch a glimpse of her brilliant future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, welcome home~.
How was work?
Satono Diamond told the two who came out to greet her about the charity race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, what a fascinating tale~!
I would love to participate in that race myself~.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Of course, absolutely! Everyone from the Mejiro family is more than welcome!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufufu♪ Since the opportunity presents itself, I shall be aiming for victory~.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, as long as we're competing, that's how it has to be!
I'll give it my all against you too♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Are we two of a kind?
Ahaha, I wonder how this'll turn out..."
